contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED (10,209.00) on the p2 Summary Page, which is also the figure printed on ALL THREE Schedule A sheets' 'Total Contributions Received (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule A pages) $10,209', and is re-stated at summary lines 4 and 5
contributions.detail: Every sheet closes on its OWN printed page subtotal to the cent, and the three subtotals reach the cover. p3: seventeen rows sum to 4,050 = its printed 'Subtotal for this page $4050'. p4: sixteen written rows sum to 4,575 = its printed '$4575' (printed line 17 is blank, crop-proved). p5, the filer's own IN-KIND sheet: six rows sum to 100 + 100 + 94 + 790 + 300 + 200 = 1,584 = its printed '$1584'. 4,050 + 4,575 + 1,584 = 10,209.00 EXACTLY = the schedule's own printed Total = the cover's promoted PER-PERIOD Column A cell. Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' also prints 10,209.00 (line 3 Balance at Beginning is a handwritten '0', so this is the cycle's first report) and is NOT summed as an increment. THE CLOSURE DECIDES TWO CLASSIFICATIONS: in-kind is counted (monetary-only stops at 8,625, which appears nowhere), and the candidate's own 1,180 on p4 is an itemized contribution row rather than a beginning balance. The p2 ladder closes: 0 + 10,209.00 = 10,209.00; 10,209.00 - 10,208.31 = 0.69 = line 7.

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE (10,208.31) on the p2 Summary Page, which is also the figure printed on ALL THREE Schedule B sheets' 'Total Expenditures Received (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule B pages) $10,208.31', and is re-stated at summary line 6
expenditures.detail: Three Schedule B sheets, each closing on its own printed subtotal to the cent. p6: seventeen rows sum to 4,268.79 = its printed 'Subtotal for this page $4268.79'. p7: seventeen rows sum to 5,209.79 = its printed '$5209.79'. p8: five rows sum to 234.82 + 133.00 + 99.60 + 62.31 + 200.00 = 729.73 = its printed '$729.73'. 4,268.79 + 5,209.79 + 729.73 = 10,208.31 EXACTLY = the schedule's own printed Total = the cover's promoted per-period Column A cell = summary line 6. Column B YTD also prints 10,208.31 (first report of the cycle) and is never summed as an increment. Three independent page subtotals closing to the cent is what confirms every digit on 39 rows.

in_kind_convention: MONETARY-PLUS-IN-KIND — a per-filer departure from the legacy_colAB family default, and this filer declares it structurally: he devoted a WHOLE SCHEDULE A SHEET to in-kind, hand-writing the sub-title 'In-Kind Contributions' under the printed heading of p5, and then rolled that sheet's subtotal into the schedule's own Total. Both conventions were tested: monetary-only gives 8,625, which matches nothing printed on the filing; monetary-plus-in-kind gives 10,209, which is simultaneously the three-subtotal chain, Schedule A's printed Total Contributions Received and the cover's Column A. In-kind counted is what closes it. (Contrast the Stanley filing in this same chunk, whose footnote EXCLUDES in-kind from the total — the treatment really is per filer.)
escalation_note: Twenty 900 dpi --value amount-cell crops (first row, last row and the line past the last row on each of the six schedule sheets, plus the mid-page controls on pp4, 5 and 8) — every one rendered the recorded figure, an empty cell where an empty cell was expected, or the page's own printed subtotal. TWO GENUINE LEGIBILITY ESCALATIONS, both on p7 date cells, re-cropped at 1400 dpi: row 7's DAY character is written over an earlier attempt and stayed unreadable, so the date is left BLANK rather than guessed; row 15's year proved to be a single '4' ('5/12/4'), which is kept verbatim and not repaired. No AMOUNT was ever in dispute — all six sheet subtotals close to the cent.
